ul.li: Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped.
Answers are intended to be short and concise.

div.h4: Click ">" below to see your team's entire submission history for this question.

search.query: index=scoreboard ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Team="$ctf_Team$" NOT Result=Hint | stats count as Attempts max(BasePointsAwarded) as BasePointsEarned max(SpeedBonusAwarded) as BonusPointsEarned sum(Penalty) as PenaltyPoints count(eval(Result=="Incorrect")) as IncorrectAttempts count(eval(Result=="Correct")) as CorrectAttempts by ctf_id Number | append [ | inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | eval Attempts=0, IncorrectAttempts=0, CorrectAttempts=0 | fields ctf_id Number Question BasePoints Attempts CorrectAttempts IncorrectAttempts ] | gethints | stats last(BasePoints) as BasePointsAvailable last(BasePointsEarned) as BasePointsEarned last(BonusPointsEarned) as BonusPointsEarned sum(PenaltyPoints) as PenaltyPoints sum(Attempts) as Attempts sum(IncorrectAttempts) as IncorrectAttempts sum(CorrectAttempts) as CorrectAttempts last(HintsAvailable) as HintsAvailable last(HintsReceived) as HintsReceived by ctf_id Number | eval Status=if(Attempts=0,"Unanswered",Status) | eval Status=if(IncorrectAttempts>0,"Incorrect",Status) | eval Status=if(CorrectAttempts>0,"Correct",Status) | fillnull value=0 BasePointsEarned BonusPointsEarned PenaltyPoints | fields ctf_id Number Status BasePointsAvailable BasePointsEarned BonusPointsEarned PenaltyPoints HintsAvailable HintsReceived | rename BasePointsAvailable as "Base Points Avail." BasePointsEarned as "Base Points Earned" BonusPointsEarned as "Bonus Points Earned" PenaltyPoints as "Penalty Points" HintsAvailable as "Hints Available" HintsReceived as "Hints Received" | search Number="$Number$"

search.query: | inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Number="$Number$" | eval Attempts=0 | fields ctf_id Number | gethints | stats values(Hints) as Hints by ctf_id Number | mvexpand Hints | spath input=Hints | fields ctf_id Number HintNumber HintCost Hint | sort Number HintNumber | rename HintCost as "Hint Cost" | search Hint=*
